description: Localization (i18n) file for the Select2 plugin for Pashto language, defining user interface messages and strings.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.
methods.returns: Pashto string indicating failure to load results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message when user input exceeds maximum allowed length.
methods.parameters: Object with 'input' (current input string) and 'maximum' (max allowed length).

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message when user input is shorter than minimum required length.
methods.parameters: Object with 'minimum' (min required length) and 'input' (current input string).

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Message shown when more results are being loaded.
methods.returns: Pashto string indicating loading more results.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Message shown when no search results are found.
methods.returns: Pashto string indicating no results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.returns: Pashto string indicating search in progress.
